topics.name: MetaModule Dependency Binding
topics.purpose: Define exact required/optional dependency bindings and compatibility constraints for MetaModules without auto-enabling or guessing missing capabilities.

semantics.identity_rule: Each dependency resolves an exact canonical/package/runtime capability identity.
semantics.optional_rule: Optional dependency absence follows explicit degraded/disabled behavior.
semantics.auto_rule: Dependency resolution never silently enables, installs or invents a component.
semantics.binding_rule: A resolved dependency binding does not transfer semantic ownership.
semantics.cycle_rule: Dependency cycles are validated explicitly and rejected unless a safe declared cycle profile exists.

invariants.rule: A MetaModule is an explicit composition of existing semantic capabilities; composition, placement or runtime activation never silently transfers ownership, identity or authority from constituent modules/resources.

references.purpose: MetaModule dependencies follow exact no-auto-enable validation.
